main.summary: Defines how the stream item's content is currently bound.

field.name: Static
field.summary: Content is statically bound through normal item semantics.

field.name: LiveSessionManaged
field.summary: Content is live-bound and managed by an active DataControl session.

main.summary: Represents the current state of live session-managed content.

field.name: None
field.summary: No live content is currently bound.

field.name: Open
field.summary: Live content is bound and may continue to append bytes.

field.name: Aborted
field.summary: Live content was aborted before completion.

field.name: Faulted
field.summary: Live content faulted and may have an associated message.
